research.title: Image Preprocessing for Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned image resizing and intensity normalization routines for surface defect classification using a predefined preprocessing specification.
Checked processed images for inconsistent dimensions and documented classification errors across lighting conditions using supplied labels and evaluation procedures.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory logs, checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, and flagged discrepancies for review by the operations supervisor.
Prepared order paperwork, organized stockroom supplies, and coordinated routine pickup schedules with staff to support daily fulfillment activities.

projects.title: Handwritten Character Classification with Pixel Features
bullets: Implemented a baseline handwritten character classifier using normalized pixel features and logistic regression within a prescribed training and evaluation workflow.
Examined confusion matrices and misclassified examples to describe common character ambiguities, keeping preprocessing consistent across training and held-out data.
